title: Sifre sifirlama
purpose: Implements FR-E1-04: Password reset via email/phone OTP, password policy enforcement (min 8 chars, letter + number), and success redirect to login.

loading.description: Skeleton email/phone input and disabled Kod Gonder button shown.

ready.description: Email/phone field with inline validation. After code sent, OTP screen opens. After OTP verified, new password form with strength meter and policy hints.

empty.description: Message explains no reset request found. Offers to start a new request.

error.description: User-safe error explaining the reset failed (e.g. network issue, invalid code), with retry.

offline.description: Form disabled, offline banner explains password reset requires connectivity.
